**Approach.** The structure is lossless and symmetric, so I split the problem into even and odd channels about the centre of the middle barrier. Write each channel's standing-wave phase as ψ ∝ sin(kx + φ) in the contacts, and let u = kψ(X)/ψ'(X) at a point X in the right contact. Then T = sin²(φ_e − φ_o), and the transmission peaks (T = 1) satisfy

u_e · u_o = −1.

This condition is independent of the phase branch. A free-particle check confirms the sign convention, since u_e·u_o = −1 identically when V = 0.

**Channel functions.** With ħ²/2m = 0.568654 eV nm² (m = 0.067 m0), k = √(E/0.568654) in the wells and contacts and κ = √((0.3 − E)/0.568654) in the barriers. Start at the middle-barrier edge x = 0.75 nm with cosh/sinh (even) or sinh/cosh (odd) forms, propagate through the 4 nm well, then through the 1.5 nm outer barrier to X = 6.25 nm.

**Numerical results** (u_e, u_o, and P = u_e·u_o):

| E (eV) | u_e | u_o | P |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.080 | +28.4 | +0.894 | +25 (just below the even pole) |
| 0.085 | −1.605 | +0.974 | −1.563 |
| 0.087 | −0.954 | +1.011 | −0.964 |
| 0.088 | −0.757 | +1.030 | −0.779 |
| 0.090 | −0.479 | +1.070 | −0.513 |
| 0.100 | +0.088 | +1.340 | +0.118 |
| 0.140 | +0.635 | −1.808 | −1.149 |
| 0.1415 | +0.648 | −1.513 | −0.981 |
| 0.150 | +0.718 | −0.620 | −0.445 |

The channel poles (ψ'(X) = 0) sit near E ≈ 0.0804 (even) and E ≈ 0.129 (odd), which is consistent with a doublet around the single-well level near 0.11 eV. Only one bound level exists per well, so the two lowest peaks are this doublet.

**Solving P = −1.**
- Lower peak: interpolating through the points at 0.085, 0.087 and 0.088 eV gives E₁ ≈ 0.08684 eV.
- Upper peak: interpolating through 0.140, 0.1415 and 0.150 eV gives E₂ ≈ 0.14132 eV.

**Cross-check.** A Herring-type estimate of the tunnelling splitting through the 1.5 nm, 0.3 eV barrier gives roughly 55 meV, which agrees with the result below.

**Splitting.**

E₂ − E₁ ≈ 0.14132 − 0.08684 ≈ 0.0545 eV ≈ 54.5 meV

Hand-arithmetic uncertainty is roughly ±0.5 meV.

ANSWER: {"splitting_meV": 54.5}
